title: Document Creation
description: Create documents from templates — pick a template, select an entity, and generate.
settingsDescription: Configure version, input mode, output formats, and diagnostics.
settingsPageDescription: Configure which templates are available in this organization and which primary record they generate for.
settingsNoTemplates: No templates are available for configuration in this organization.
configureDescription: Choose a template, provide data, and create downloadable outputs.
inputEditorDescription: Fill out the template fields below before generating the document.
inputEditorResolverDescription: Resolved values can be overridden field by field before generating the document.
outputOptionsDescription: Choose which files should be generated for this run.
placeholderDescription: The selected published version defines the available placeholders.
historyDescription: Previously generated documents for this organization.
diagnosticsDescription: Diagnostics appear automatically when the selected template and input are valid.
noLinkedFuneralCases: This contact is not linked to any funeral cases that can be used for document generation.
preGenerationWarningTitle: Some template fields are still missing values.
preGenerationWarningDescription: You can still generate the document, but incomplete fields may remain empty in the result.
unsupportedTemplateDescription: This template uses Word field-code features that the current renderer does not support reliably. Generated documents may still be incomplete or broken.
draftPreviewDescription: A PDF rendered from your current inputs. Nothing is saved until you generate the document.
funeralCasePreviewAutoRefreshHint: After the first preview, the PDF refreshes automatically a moment after you stop editing.
funeralCasePreviewEmptyHint: Use the Preview button in the footer to render a PDF from the fields on the left.
optionalUnfilledConfirmDescription: The following fields are not required for generation but have no value yet. They may appear blank in the document. Confirm to continue.
previewPdfRequired: PDF preview needs PDF output to be available.
deleteGenerationDescription: It will be removed from the list and the generated files will be moved to trash.

validation.selectOutputFormat: Select at least one output format.
validation.funeralCaseIdRequired: Enter a funeral case ID to resolve values.
validation.selectPrimaryEntityType: Select a primary entity type for this template.
validation.templateNotConfigured: This template is not configured for runtime generation yet.
validation.completeMissingFields: Fill in all highlighted missing fields before generating the document.

noGenerationYet: No document has been generated yet.
missingKeysNotice: Generation completed with {{count}} missing placeholder values.
missingFieldsFormDescription: {{count}} required field(s) are still missing. Fill them in before generating the document.
jsonEditorDescription: Advanced: edit the template input payload as JSON. Changes stay in sync with the field form.
fieldsWarningTooltip: Some template fields could not be filled. The document may be incomplete.
allFieldsResolved: All template fields were resolved from the database. No manual input needed.
writeBackSuccess: {{count}} field(s) were saved back to the funeral case.
noGeneratePermission: You don't have permission to generate documents.
templateSheetMissingDescription: Fill in the missing fields below, then generate.
templateSheetCompleteDescription: All fields are resolved. Ready to generate.
discardTemplateFieldChangesHint: Restores funeral case field overrides from before this dialog was opened. Closing the dialog otherwise saves your edits automatically.
autoGenerateFuneralCaseWhenReadyLabel: Auto-generate when the case is ready
autoGenerateFuneralCaseWhenReadyDescript: When enabled, saving a funeral case generates this document automatically once all resolver placeholders are filled. Requires permission to generate documents. Existing completed generations for this template are not replaced; use Regenerate on the case if the data changed.
entitySlotsDescription: Select which contacts or locations staff should provide when generating this template.
autoDetectTooltip: Detect required contacts and locations from template placeholder keys
autoDetectHint: Dashed badges show detected slots from the template. Click or use "Auto-detect" to activate them.
autoDetectAllNoChanges: All templates are already up to date.

signaturePlacement.title: Signature placement
signaturePlacement.description: Drag the signature box to move it. The preview PDF uses these values.
signaturePlacement.dialogDescription: Move and resize the signature, then close this window to continue with the preview.
signaturePlacement.previewHint: Adjust signature placement from the popup when needed.

supportIssues.hidden_placeholders: Hidden placeholders without visible fallback tags

wordTemplatesLibraryDescription: See all Word templates your organization can use. You can add your own templates and update their files. Built-in (global) templates: you choose where they appear under Template Settings; Oktavius maintains the files.
wordTemplatesLibraryLead: Open a template to replace the live Word file in one step, or adjust the title. Use Template Settings to turn templates on or off and link them to funeral cases.

adminWordTemplates.listDescription: {{count}} Word template(s) visible in this organization.
adminWordTemplates.listOpenRowHint: Click a name to edit that template: replace the live Word file, change the title, or preview a PDF.
adminWordTemplates.createDescription: Add a new .docx-based template that belongs to your organization. The key must be unique within your organization.
adminWordTemplates.createKeyHelp: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes (e.g. thank-you-letter). This is the internal reference — it cannot be changed later.
adminWordTemplates.createOptionalTechnicalBody: Leave these as they are unless you know you need something different. Most organizations use the defaults.
adminWordTemplates.createInitialUploadBody: Upload your first Word file now to start with version 1 immediately.
adminWordTemplates.createDropzoneTitle: Drop .docx files here or click to choose
adminWordTemplates.createDropzoneHint: Drop one or more .docx files here or click to browse
adminWordTemplates.createModeHelpGeneric: Best default. Works with any DOCX placeholders and manual values.
adminWordTemplates.createModeHelpFuneralFo: Use this when placeholders should auto-fill from funeral case data.
adminWordTemplates.kindHelpWord: Upload a .docx template with placeholders like {{name}}.
adminWordTemplates.kindHelpPdfMerge: Merge uploaded PDFs, images, and emails into one PDF using ordering rules. Configure the rules after creating the template.
adminWordTemplates.noTemplatesDescription: No templates are available yet. Create an organization template (Word placeholder or PDF merge) or ask Oktavius to publish global templates.
adminWordTemplates.globalReadOnlyDescription: You can preview versions and adjust availability under Template Settings. Uploading, publishing, and editing the definition is limited to Oktavius.
adminWordTemplates.orgEditableHint: This template belongs to your organization. You can edit metadata, upload versions, and publish.
adminWordTemplates.detailIntroOrg: Update the live Word file at the top, or adjust the name below. Version history and draft steps stay under “Advanced workflow” if you need them.
adminWordTemplates.detailIntroGlobal: You can preview file versions here. To turn this template on or off for your team, or set which funeral case fields are required, use Template Settings.
adminWordTemplates.templateNotFound: This template is no longer available.
adminWordTemplates.deleteDescription: This soft-deletes the template for your organization. Existing generations keep their files.
adminWordTemplates.uploadDescription: Upload a .docx file as a new draft version. Publish it when you are ready for staff to generate documents.
adminWordTemplates.previewDescription: Render a PDF from the selected version using sample data or a funeral case.
adminWordTemplates.sectionBasicsBody: This is what people see in lists. Save after you make changes.
adminWordTemplates.sectionActiveHelp: When off, staff cannot start new documents from this template.
adminWordTemplates.sectionAdvancedBody: Leave these as they are unless support asked you to change them.
adminWordTemplates.sectionVersionBody: Each row is one uploaded Word file. Staff always use the published version for new documents. Pick a version to preview or download an older file.
adminWordTemplates.sectionVersionEmpty: No Word file has been uploaded yet.

versionStatus.published: Published — in use for new documents
versionStatus.draft: Draft — not used until you publish

adminWordTemplates.sectionUploadBody: Choose a .docx file and describe what you changed. This always creates a new draft first. It does not change what staff use until you publish that draft.
adminWordTemplates.uploadNoteHelp: Drop a .docx file or click to browse
adminWordTemplates.sectionPublishBody: Publishing replaces the current "live" file for this template. Only draft versions can be published.
adminWordTemplates.publishNoteHelp: Required. Example: "Go live with March layout update."
adminWordTemplates.publishHintSelectDraft: Select a draft version in "Which file version?" above, then publish it here.
adminWordTemplates.sectionArchiveBody: Archiving hides this version from use. Use this when an old file should no longer be chosen.
adminWordTemplates.detectedSlotsBody: Based on placeholder names in this version, these contacts/locations are likely needed during generation.
adminWordTemplates.detectedSlotsEmpty: No known contact/location groups were detected from this version.
adminWordTemplates.detectedSlotsApply: Use detected groups in template settings
adminWordTemplates.detectedSlotsApplied: Detected groups saved for this template.
adminWordTemplates.sectionSimpleReplaceBody: Upload a .docx and publish it immediately. The previous live file is kept in history as an archived version.
adminWordTemplates.sectionAdvancedWorkflowBody: Use this only if you need a draft without publishing, or to archive a specific version.
adminWordTemplates.sectionPreviewBody: Builds a PDF and opens it in a new browser tab. Prefer a real funeral case; test JSON is optional.
adminWordTemplates.previewCaseHelp: Placeholder values are taken from the case you select.
adminWordTemplates.previewSampleHelp: Paste JSON with placeholder keys and text values. Only used when no case is selected.
adminWordTemplates.previewPickCaseRequired: Choose a funeral case to preview.
adminWordTemplates.sectionFieldsBody: Every placeholder the Word file expects. When people generate a document, the system fills these from the funeral case (or from test data in preview).
adminWordTemplates.sectionFieldsEmpty: No placeholders were found in this file, or no version is selected.
adminWordTemplates.sectionPreviewLayoutHint: Choose a version above, then pick how to fill the preview. The list on the left matches this Word file.
adminWordTemplates.previewOpensInTabHint: Use “Preview PDF” — the result opens in a new tab (allow pop-ups if nothing appears).
adminWordTemplates.previewPopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
adminWordTemplates.previewOpenedInTab: Preview opened in a new tab.
adminWordTemplates.createModeHelpResolver: Use this when placeholders should auto-fill from {{resolver}} data.

pdfMerge.rulesDescription: Each uploaded file is tested against these rules in order. The first rule a file matches determines its position. Files that match no rule go to the default bucket.
pdfMerge.noRules: No rules yet. Add a rule to pin a file to a specific position.
pdfMerge.ruleRequired: Required — fail if no file matches
pdfMerge.ruleMultiple: Allow multiple — include every matching file
pdfMerge.defaultBucketInclude: Include unmatched files in the merged PDF
pdfMerge.generateDescription: Upload the PDFs, images, and emails you want merged. The template rules will decide the order.
pdfMerge.invoiceHelp: The generated PDF is linked to the invoice and saved into the invoice's project folder.
pdfMerge.dropzoneTitle: Drop files here or click to choose
pdfMerge.noFilesError: Upload at least one file before generating.
pdfMerge.storageLocationHint: Saved inside the invoice's project folder
